subject: Where is my face cream?
body: I ordered a face cream from you last week and the tracking says it was delivered to a store for pickup, but I can't figure out which store. The email just says it's ready and gives a pickup window, no address anywhere. I checked the app and my account and still nothing. I've been to two locations near me already and neither had it. Can someone tell me where I'm supposed to go? This is getting frustrating.
